messages:
sam_sales: Heads up — Acme POC hitting 403 on /v1/generate after we rotated keys this morning. Demo in ~2h, customer is blocked.

olivia_se: Ugh, on it. Do we have the request headers from their failing curl? Which env (staging/prod)?

sam_sales: staging. They sent this snippet:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk.live.XXX' -H 'X-Project-Id: acme-prod' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# -> 403 {\"error\":\"organization mismatch\"}
```

mike_infra: That header X-Project-Id looks suspicious — their key is tied to trial-org-123, not acme-prod. If their client set the wrong project header we return org binding 403.

nina_support: Quick checklist:
- Verify key binding in console (Dashboard -> API Keys)
- Confirm which tenant the key belongs to
- Check if there was a recent rotate/regen event

sam_sales: I checked — Sales dashboard shows key created under trial-org-123 at 10:12am. Customer claims they used the key from the UI but their app config file still had X-Project-Id set to acme-prod from an old demo.

olivia_se: Can we detect mismatched project header and return a more actionable error? Right now it says "organization mismatch" which confuses customers.

mike_infra: Agree. We have a bug ticket for clearer errors but not in time for demo. Short fix: tell them to remove X-Project-Id header (server will infer from key) or set correct project id to trial-org-123.

sam_sales: Sent that to customer — they tried removing header and now get 200 for a ping, but their app framework still intermittently caches old header.

deploy-bot: new_key_event: key sk.live.ABC created for trial-org-123 by olivia_se @ 2024-05-02T10:12:04Z

nina_support: If caching is the issue, ask them to restart their app or flush env var cache. Also will add a quick snippet for them:
```
# node example
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer sk.live.ABC' }
})
```

olivia_se: Customer restarted and now tests are green. Follow-up: they asked if rotating keys causes a propagation delay across our edge nodes — they saw ~30s where old key still worked then stopped.

mike_infra: No propagation lag expected for valid keys; rotation should be immediate. But if they were hitting an edge with cached mapping it could take a short TTL to evict. I'll check logs for multi-edge cache TTLs.

sam_sales: Also they had a pricing question — if they go to dedicated for this demo scale (30 req/s sustained) what would that look like? I told them I'll ping sales ops after the demo.

nina_support: Closing action items: (1) mike to confirm cache TTL and add note in docs about header vs key inference (2) olivia to update presales checklist to warn about stale X-Project-Id env vars (3) sam to follow up on pricing after demo.

olivia_se: Thanks everyone — demo moved to green. Will add a tiny FAQ entry: "If you see org mismatch 403, check project header and restart app" :thumbsup:

sam_sales: Legend, appreciate the quick swarm. :raised_hands:
